user.title: Setup Trinnov Altitude
user.description: Your device needs to be on in order to add the integration. Enter a MAC address for explicit Wake-on-LAN targeting, or leave it blank to use automatic discovery when possible.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Trinnov Altitude device. Be sure to configure your IP address to be static.
data_description.mac: Optional explicit MAC address for Wake-On-LAN. Leave blank to auto-discover it from the local network when possible.

init.title: Trinnov Altitude Options
init.description: Configure Wake-on-LAN targeting. Saving reloads the integration immediately. Leave the defaults for a standard local network.

data_description.mac: The receiver MAC address used for Wake-on-LAN.
data_description.wol_host: Broadcast IP or hostname; default 255.255.255.255. VLAN routing must permit delivery.
data_description.wol_interface: Optional local IP address inside the Home Assistant network environment, not an interface name. Leave blank for automatic routing.
data_description.wol_family: IPv4 preserves the default behavior; choose IPv6 only for an IPv6 destination.

error.invalid_wol_interface: Enter a local IP address, or leave blank for automatic routing.
